name: @workspace/tool-logic-hash
description: The Hash tool's logic (D14, docs/tools/specs/hash.md): MD5, SHA-1, SHA-2 and HMAC of bytes and files (a Digester seam: hash-wasm by default, @noble/hashes the other), input parsing, output formats, comparison with an expected digest. Pure TypeScript: no React, no DOM, no chrome.
